svg.title: The observed pivot through Artifactory
svg.desc: Trace workload through Artifactory to the supported internal destinations. End the diagram at that evidence limit; administrative persistence belongs to a different knowledge stage. Visual distinction: A solid tiled network wall with disconnected cable ends. Indicates unavailable reach, not a decision awaiting human approval.
